item.title: Lattice light sheet activation structured illumination super-resolution microscopy
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 28 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-02019-6 Lattice light sheet activation structured illumination microscopy (LA-SIM) enhances volumetric super-resolution by over twofold compared to the diffraction limit, enabling multicolour 3D imaging of subcellular dynamics in living cells and embryos

item.title: Programmable photonic unitary processor enables parameterized differentiable long-haul spatial division multiplexed transmission
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 25 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01997-x A programmable photonic unitary processor for compensating modal dispersion allows long-haul (1,300 km) high-quality data transmission over a three-mode fibre.

item.title: Observation of multiphoton entanglement in resonance fluorescence
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 24 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-02022-x Multiphoton scattering process is extracted from the resonance fluorescence of a single 87Rb atom. Tripartite entanglement between the photons is verified by a violation of Svetlichny’s inequality. A quantum secret sharing protocol is demonstrated as an application example.

item.title: Attosecond streaking of photoelectron angular momentum
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 24 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-02020-z Angle-resolved attosecond streaking measurements are performed on helium and neon to probe the evolution of continuum-electron partial waves during continuum–continuum transitions, and uncover the angular momentum of continuum-electron peaks at the crest of the electric field.

item.title: Volumetrically continuous 3D dynamic holography via cascaded light-field propagation
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-02016-9 Cascaded light-field propagation enhances three-dimensional holography by transforming crosstalk into constructive signals. Using an untrained neural framework, the method achieves continuous projections along with improvements in contrast and spatial resolution without extensive computational demands.

item.title: Millimetre-wave generation with 18 zs Hz<sup>−1/2</sup> timing noise floor via Kerr optical frequency division
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-02014-x Low-noise millimetre-waves are generated by injection-locking a Kerr microcomb to a dual-wavelength Brillouin laser, which serves as the optical reference. A timing noise floor of 18 zs Hz−1/2 is achieved. The integrated timing jitter is 135 as from 1 kHz to 1 MHz.

item.description: Quantum photonics could be a pivotal part of future quantum technology if the right materials can be created, a new review paper has found.

item.description: Scientists have shown that the two exponents (inelastic scattering exponent and dephasing exponent) commonly used to describe electron scattering in graphene do not necessarily follow the same behavior. item.title: Physicists crack the math connecting ultraslow quantum magnetism to ultrafast black-hole physics
item.description: A team led by University at Buffalo physicists has found a mathematical solution that shows how a frustrated quantum magnet can transition from ultraslow behavior to ultrafast, highly entangled behavior resembling that of a black hole.

item.title: Quantum communication protocol enables three users to establish a shared secure key
item.description: Quantum key distribution allows two users to establish secret keys whose security is grounded in the laws of quantum mechanics. Extending this capability to multiple users is an essential step toward quantum networks that support secure communication among many participants. Quantum cryptographic conferencing addresses this need by enabling multiple users to share the same secure key, which they can then use to protect group communications.

item.title: 工信部召开务虚会 研究谋划“十五五”及开局之年工作：以综合整治“内卷式”竞争为重点
item.description: 2025年12月7日，工业和信息化部党组书记、部长李乐成主持召开务虚会，深入学习贯彻党的二十届四中全会精神，研究谋划“十五五”及开局之年工作思路和举措。部领导辛国斌、叶民、张云明、熊继军、柯吉欣、单忠德、谢远生、张建民、高东升、谢少锋、钟志红出席会议，结合分管领域工作逐一发言，交流学习体会，分析研判当前形势，提出意见建议。
